purpose: Verify the previously supplied/approved external-repository work without expanding the strategy-search scope.

sources.name: midas-agent
evidence: README identifies an 8-agent XAUUSD M15 framework.
ultimate_gold_hunter.py combines Kronos H1/M15/M5 forecasting, TradingView M15 analysis, an LLM council, a deterministic M15-neutral no-trade gate and deterministic SL/risk constraints.
Trade direction is not produced by one self-contained fixed-parameter deterministic strategy suitable for the baseline tournament.

conclusion: BOT-04_COMPLETE. XAU-60 provides the external deterministic tournament candidates. Midas Agent is retained as a later AI-supervisor/orchestration reference rather than being misrepresented as a deterministic baseline strategy.
